review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–83) and the signature of gradedSimpleClassBasis in CartanMap/SimpleBasis.lean. The file defines one basis, `gradedIdempotentHeadBasis`, which is already a bundled `Module.Basis`. It also has two simp lemmas, for `apply` and `repr_apply`. The upstream basis builder takes the data and hypotheses as arguments. The hypotheses `hneg`, `he`, `he₀`, `hspan` and `hne` recur across about 10 files in this directory. I could have proposed a `Prop`-valued structure to hold them. That would be optional packaging, and I did not see a consumer it would clearly simplify. The restated head-family subtype in `gradedIdempotentHeadBasis_apply` repeats the private `headFamily`. That is a naming and duplication issue, not a missing mathematical structure, so I did not report it. I found no clear failure to expose structure under this rubric. I did not trace every consumer of the hypothesis bundle across the library.
